aboutGame.title: What is False Hero?
paragraphs: False Hero is a fast-paced dark fantasy soulslike action RPG developed by Torchlight Games and published by Ytopia. Emphasizing fluid execution over passive level grinding, the game puts you in the mantle of a masked scholar navigating the corrupted Land of the Gods.

Rather than relying solely on conventional weapon trees, your survivability depends on siphoning lethal combat arts from fallen foes. Master precision parries, chain stolen abilities, and conquer colossal bosses in an unforgiving handcrafted world.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about False Hero gameplay, combat mechanics, and progression.

items.question: What kind of game is False Hero?
items.answer: False Hero is a fast-paced retro-styled soulslike action RPG where players explore a corrupted realm ruled by fallen gods, defeat monsters, and siphon enemy movesets into customizable combat art combos.

items.question: How does the ability stealing mechanic work in False Hero?
items.answer: Defeating enemies in False Hero causes their kinetic essence to linger for a brief window. Using your relic mask during this opening lets you extract their signature technique and equip up to five active combat arts.

items.question: How do you build Focus to cast Combat Arts in False Hero?
items.answer: In False Hero, basic sword strikes consume stamina but recharge your Focus Points (FP). You then spend Focus to unleash your heavy-hitting stolen abilities.

items.question: Can you customize builds and passive perks in False Hero?
items.answer: Yes, False Hero allows you to equip up to five active stolen combat arts and three passive mask scrolls that modify damage output, Focus regeneration rates, and defensive buffs.

items.question: What platforms is False Hero available on?
items.answer: False Hero is available on PC via Steam, featuring full support for both Xbox and PlayStation controllers as well as keyboard and mouse setups.
